name: Brothers-in-Law
description: Aliyans (Brothers-in-Law) is a hit Malayalam sitcom on Kaumudy TV, directed by Rajesh Thalachira. It premiered on February 24, 2020, as a sequel to Aliyan vs Aliyan (Brother-in-Law vs Brother-in-Law). Set in Thiruvananthapuram, the show follows Ratnamma and her family, centering on the love-hate dynamic between brothers-in-law Kanakan and Cleatus. Most episodes revolve around Cleatus landing in trouble thanks to his quirky ideas, with Kanakan often stepping in to save the day.

videos.title: The Story Goes Like This
videos.overview: Aliyans is a family comedy sitcom of Kaumudy TV. Its about the love - hate relationship between two brother-in-laws and their families. Aneesh Ravi, Soumya Bhagyananthan, Riyas Narmakala, Manju Pathrose, Sethulekshmi, Binoj Kulathoor, Mani Shornur and Akshayamol. Aliyans is directed by Rajesh Thalachira.

videos.title: Search for Cleatus
videos.overview: When a Sheikh from Dubai comes in search of Cleatus, everyone starts believing that Cleatus has messed up something in Dubai and the Sheikh is after his life. How will Cleatus save himself from the Sheikh? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Kanakan Gets the Chit Funds
videos.overview: Kanakan tells Lilly and Thankam that based on the lucky draw, he has won the Chit Funds. But as soon as they come to know about it, they ask for their share to fulfill their wishes. Helpless Kanakan couldn't refuse but shared with them. Later a man visits Kanakan to ask for some money, but will Lilly and Thankam give up on their share to help the man? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Jasmine Flowers
videos.overview: After much pondering, Thambi finally finds a new job, but he hides it from her wife, Sulu, saying that he has got a job but didn't reveal where he has got the job. Sulu suspects that her husband, Thambi is having an extra-marital affair which makes her heavily disappointed as she gets a scent of Jasmine flowers from Thambi's shirt. Is Thambi really having an extra-marital affair? Find out to know more.

videos.title: The Speech
videos.overview: Takkuddu tells his mother that he has got a chance to give a speech in his school. On hearing this, his mom gets annoyed and stops talking to him till the time he backs off from giving the speech. Later Thankam's brother and his wife consoles her and pacifies her. Takkudu tells his mom that he removed his name from the list. What happens next? Find out to know more.

videos.title: Service Co-operation Bank Lilly
videos.overview: Thambi visits Lilly and gives her some money to keep it safe with her as she thinks that her wife, Sulu will spend all his earned money which he had earned from his acting classes, till Thambi asks for it. Later, Lilly gives that money to Kanakan to help his friend, Suresh, for his child's medical expenses. Later Thambi visits Lilly and asks for his money back as he has to give it to repay the loan which he took from a moneylender. Now what will Lilly do? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Kanakan's Ooty Trip
videos.overview: Ronald receives a message from Kanakan saying that he and his friends have been arrested by the Tamil Nadu Police for partying with a few girls in a hotel room in Ooty. He shares this news from Girirajan but hides it from the other family members. Later Thankam learns the truth from Ronald after getting at his back and consoles Lilly after informing her. After a while, Kanakan returns from the trip, but all are angry on him. What's the truth? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Fight for the Set Saree
videos.overview: Thankam and Girija, both of them selected the same few set sarees which were gifted to Ratnamma, because of which, they had an argument. Now the men of the house have decided to convince both of them to wear the set sarees or else Ratnamma had decide to donate it to Orphanage. Will the men succeed? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Girija's Chain Goes Missing
videos.overview: Ronald asks for some money from Thankam which she refuses to give. Later Ronald visits Ratnamma thinking that she might agree to give money but is a bit doubtful. Later when he comes to know that Amma is getting ready to collect pension from the bank, that's when he agrees to join her. Meanwhile Girija keeps the chain on the table of her room and goes to take bath. After returning, she notices that her chain goes missing and later calls Lilly and Thankam to search for it. Thankam raises doubt that Ronald might have stolen it to get some hard cash in exchange of that. Does her suspicion come out to be true? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Fear of Girija's Anger
videos.overview: Ronald informs Thankam that Girirajan felt unconscious and has been sent to the hospital. On return, they informed the family members that it was due to weakness and so they suggested him to do a few physical exercises. Girirajan refuses but Girija warns him that if he doesn't follow, she will impose stricter restrictions on him. Later Girija finds a stick in Girirajan's shirt's pocket which later Lilly identifies it as a smoke weed. What happens next? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Men of Kerala Association
videos.overview: Ronald has plans to start an association having all the men of Kerala who are tired of their wife's tantrum and his association aims to solve the problems of the men. Will he succeed in this movement? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Who Gets to Have the Dosa Pan?
videos.overview: Lilly, on Thankam's behest, purchases a Dosa Pan for her from a salesgirl who's very young. Later, Girirajan reveals that Lilly has been cheated by that girl as Girirajan purchased a similar dosa pan for even lesser price. On hearing this, Thankam refuses to take the pan from Lilly and also decides not to repay her for the pan she purchased. Who gets to have the pan? Will Thankam accept it? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Scooter Needs a Repair
videos.overview: Kanakan, who takes pride and good care of his scooter, find out that his scooter isn't working properly. Voluntarily, Ronald promises to Kanakan that he'll fix his scooter as soon as possible. Will Ronald succeed? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Movie Review
videos.overview: Ronald, in order to earn some money, decides to open his YouTube channel for reviewing the movies. Everything was going well, later his greediness takes over him. Now what will happen? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Ratnamma's Fear
videos.overview: Ratnamma's friend visits her for the last time before leaving this city as her children does not treat her properly. On hearing this, Ratnamma starts to worry, whether her children and her family would treat her in the same manner as her friend was treated. Later, Kanakan (who left early without meeting Ratnamma), Lilly, Thankam, Takkuddu and Ronald couldn't pay attention to her as they were busy with their work. How will the family members console Ratnamma? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Ronald Takes up the Job of Loading and Unloading Goods
videos.overview: Ronald receives a phone call from Rosemary, who requests financial assistance to settle an overdue electricity bill, which has led to a power outage at his residence. In response, Ronald seeks monetary help from his relatives, but only Lilly offers support. Upon noticing the money in Ronald's possession, Kanakan chastises him for frequently relying on family for financial aid. This prompts Ronald to accept a job involving the loading and unloading of goods at a vegetable shop, which pleases Kanakan as he observes Ronald's newfound work ethic. However, as news of Ronald's situation spreads, his family members begin to feel sympathy for him. Tune in to discover more!

videos.title: Where is Ratnamma's Phone?
videos.overview: Lilly and Kanakan leaves from their home to attend a wedding. Lilly informs Amma that she has prepared the rice but couldn't find the time to make the curry, so she suggests Amma to go to Thankam's place to have the food from there. Later Thankam gets a call from Cleatus asking her to get his important document, leaving Amma, Takkuddu and Ronald behind. Amma reprimands Takkuddu for taking her mobile phone and snatches it away. Later she kept it away from his reach, near the windowsill in the kitchen but later it goes missing from there. Everyone suspects Takkuddu. Has he lost or damaged Amma's phone? Watch the episode to know more!

videos.title: Ronald's Plan Goes in Vain
videos.overview: Thankam becomes upset with Lilly after she instructs her to remain silent so that the Ladies Meeting can proceed. Subsequently, a sister named Mini visits Lilly to provide a loan for her husband's medical treatment. Ronald discovers the truth about Mini's deception from Sister Omana who had spoken ill of her. Ronald's intention is to expose Mini's dishonesty in front of Lilly and Kanakan the following day when she comes to collect the loan, aiming to impress them. Meanwhile, Thankam secretly learns the full story from Ronald, who was overheard discussing the incident and his plan to reveal it over the phone. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: The Ladies' Conversational Gathering
videos.overview: When Thankam, Lilly and Takkuddu were returning from the temple, they met Sister Omana, who's heading to meet one of their acquaintances, who are dealing with their family problems. On hearing this, Thankam and Lilly requests Omana to come to their place to give them updates after meeting them. Once Omana reaches, she tells the story to Lilly, Thankam and Ratnamma! What happens next? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Ratnamma Gets Into an Argument With Lilly
videos.overview: Ratnamma admonishes Lilly for her negligence in leaving the gas stove on while the rice cooker is preparing the rice. Subsequently, in an effort to support Amma, Thankam engages in a dispute with Lilly, which disturbs Kanakan's tranquility. Eventually, news of Kanakan's unexpected transfer spreads among everyone. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to discover more!

videos.title: Ronald Demands for a Scooter
videos.overview: Thankam and Lilly ask Ronald to purchase some grocery items, but he returns home late, causing frustration among everyone. He proposes that if they buy him a scooter, he will be able to complete his errands quickly, thus saving both time and money. Will they agree to his request? Watch now to discover more!

videos.title: Just One Look at Me
videos.overview: Akshaya calls Thankam requesting her to ask someone to pick her up from the hostel as all of her friends have gone to their parent's place for a few days. Thankam, at first relucted, later Lilly convinced her to allow her to come back from the hostel. Later, Sulu's cousin brother, Lallu, learns the news of Akshaya's return and is wanting her to see once! Will his dream be fulfilled? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Thankam and Cleatus Argue With Each Other
videos.overview: Thankam chastises Cleatus for spending the funds that were specifically set aside for Akshaya's hostel and tuition fees on his party expenses. As a result, they have chosen to live apart and refrain from communicating. What will be the resolution of their conflict? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Akshaya Centre
videos.overview: Kanakan expresses his intention to establish an Akshaya Centre, not in the name of his wife, Lilly, but rather in the name of her sister, Thankam. This revelation leaves Lilly feeling disheartened and troubled, however, Kanakan eventually persuades her to see his perspective. Subsequently, both Lilly and Kanakan come to the realization that Thankam does not meet the necessary criteria to qualify as a candidate for opening the Akshaya Centre, which makes her feel upset. Will Kanakan succeed in launching the Akshaya Centre? If so, under whose name will it be registered? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Rising Heatwave
videos.overview: Thankam requests a new table fan from Cleatus, as the existing fan in their room is inoperative and the rising heatwave is making it difficult for them to sleep. She hands Cleatus 2000 Rupees to purchase a new fan, but he instead brings back a fan that has been unused at Girirajan's residence. When Thankam asks for a refund, Cleatus refuses, claiming he used the money to fulfill his party obligations. However, it later comes to light that he had actually given the money to settle a debt. What will unfold next? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Breaking the Fast
videos.overview: A distressed woman seeks assistance from Cleatus, hoping he will confront the moneylender who has threatened to evict her and her two children. Regrettably, Cleatus declines to help because of avenging his revenge against her former husband for deceiving Cleatus. Observing her sorrow and disappointment, Thankam and Lilly devise a strategy to provide financial support to the woman. Will their plan be successful? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Ethakka Appam With Beef Fry
videos.overview: When Kanakan, Lilly and Ratnamma were trying to pacify Thankam and Cleatus as they were arguing with each other, on the other hand, Girirajan and Girija Ammayi were arguing with each together while coming to their place, as Girija refused to have Beef Fry and Pazham Poori, a combination which only a few Keralites like. That's when the men of the house decided to give the ladies of the house, a taste of this combination. Will they succeed? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Half Price Scam
videos.overview: In the initial scene, Girirajan and Thankam engage in a dispute over a minor issue. Subsequently, news of the Half Price Scheme spreads, voluntarily prompting Girirajan to give Lilly 1000 Rupees to purchase a coupon worth 3000 Rupees. Witnessing this, Thankam feels envious and urges Cleatus to ask Girirajan for an additional 1000 Rupees to obtain her own coupon. Will Girirajan extend his generosity to Thankam as well? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Addiction Free Kerala Campaign
videos.overview: Members of the DDT Party, in collaboration with opposition party members, have initiated a campaign aimed at educating the youth about the dangers of illegal drug use for their own well-being. Meanwhile, Lilly, Thankam, and other Kudumbashree members are visiting the nearby neighborhood to promote this initiative. During their outreach, they encounter a woman who appears to be in distress but conceals her situation from them. Will she seek their assistance? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Lilly's Secretary Position at Stake
videos.overview: Thankam informs everyone that Lilly failed to perform her duties as the Secretary of the Kudambashree Group and might be expelled from the position of Secretary and Thankam has a higher chance of regaining her position. That's when Ronald comes up with a plan to save Lilly. Will his plan work? Find out to know more!

videos.title: A Trip to Munnar
videos.overview: Ronald receives information from a friend who claims to have seen Cleatus and Kanakan in Munnar. Thankam and Lilly find it hard to believe that they might be betraying them instead of fulfilling their work obligations. Is Ronald's account accurate? Are Kanakan and Cleatus being dishonest with their families? Uncover the truth!

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 1
videos.overview: While playing, Nallu and Saiyyu noticed that Ratnamma appeared sad and disheartened, and they suspected that she might have been crying. They inquired about her feelings, but Ratnamma chose not to share the truth with them. Later, Thankam also noticed her distress and posed the same question, yet Ratna Amma again withheld her feelings. Eventually, during lunch, Ratnamma opened up to everyone about her disappointment. Shortly after, two unexpected guests arrived at Kanakan's residence, seeking information about Cleatus. Upon their arrival, Cleatus appeared visibly distressed. Who are these visitors, and what has caused Cleatus's unease? Uncover the details to find out more!

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 2
videos.overview: Tom and Jessy, an eloped couple, seek refuge, triggering comedic attempts to hide them. The episode focuses on the humorous situations and the family's efforts to maintain secrecy from others.

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 3
videos.overview: The eloped couple's presence creates legal and political worries, given their influential families. A politician's statement adds tension. The episode follows the family's attempts to manage the situation, ending with the couple's departure.

videos.title: The Book of Troubles - Part 4
videos.overview: The family focuses on convincing the eloped couple to leave their refuge. The episode is filled with comedic situations and dialogues as the family attempts to solve the problem and get the couple to leave.

videos.title: The Vishu Celebrations
videos.overview: On the fortunate occasion of Vishu, a young girl arrives at Kanakan's home inquiring about his whereabouts from his family. Regrettably, Kanakan is not at home and will be returning late from work. Upon learning this, the girl chooses to remain there until she can meet him. Subsequently, Ronald discloses a startling revelation about the girl to his family. What prompts this mysterious girl's visit? What is her motive for wanting to see Kanakan? Discover the answers to these questions!

videos.title: The Armchair
videos.overview: Ronald, inebriated, occupies the armchair at Kanakan's residence. Upon noticing this, Girirajan admonishes him, stating that only he and Kanakan, following Kanakan's father, are permitted to use the armchair. Ronald, feeling offended by this trivial matter, engages in a dispute with Girirajan and declares his intention to never return. What unfolds next? Stay tuned to discover more!

videos.title: The Missing Blue Churidar
videos.overview: Two representatives from a charitable organization visited the homes to collect unused clothing and solicit donations from both households. As Lilly and Thankam were occupied with their domestic tasks, they asked the men to return at a later time. Upon their return, Lilly donated her old clothes and proceeded to Thankam's residence to retrieve the garments that Thankam had placed on the table. After the men departed, Thankam inquired about a missing blue churidar that she had set aside for alterations, which had been given to her by a friend. Eventually, Thankam realizes that Lilly inadvertently included that churidar with her old clothes when she donated them. Will they be able to retrieve it from the charity, or will Thankam need to compensate her friend? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: The Buttermilk
videos.overview: Ronald asked Thankam for some food to satisfy his hunger; however, she declined his request due to a dispute with Cleatus, which resulted in the spices she was sautéing being burned. Subsequently, Thankam's creditor, Sister Savitri, visited her to collect the money owed, but Thankam was unable to repay the debt as Cleatus had taken the funds. She then asked Ronald to provide an excuse, but in his pursuit of making some money, Ronald deceived Thankam. Shortly thereafter, seeking to quench his thirst, Ronald went out in search of buttermilk but was unable to find any. He eventually made some at home, but soon experienced loose motions. What could be the cause of this? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Thankam's Birthday Celebration
videos.overview: Thankam shares her wish with Cleatus to visit a temple and enjoy breakfast from outside in celebration of her upcoming birthday. Cleatus promptly agrees to fulfill his wife's request. Upon their return, when questioned about their outing, Cleatus discloses that it was Thankam's birthday. This revelation surprises everyone, particularly Kanakan, who had forgotten the occasion, further upsetting Thankam, especially since she was already feeling the absence of Akshaya. Meanwhile, Takkuddu finds himself in trouble after creating a mess. How will they resolve this situation? How will Kanakan make amends with Thankam? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Teaching Thambi a Lesson
videos.overview: Thambi, eager to evict his new tenants, a police officer and his wife, employs various strategies to achieve his goal, yet all his attempts prove futile. It is at this point that the police team devises a scheme to intimidate Thambi and teach him a lesson. Will they be successful? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Swapping Identities
videos.overview: Thankam notifies Lilly that a young woman from the Microfinance bank is scheduled to arrive today to collect the chit funds. Thankam is anxious upon learning that Sister Sulu failed to repay Thankam with the necessary funds, as she doesn't have money, leaving her unable to pay the full amount to the young woman. Subsequently, the young woman arrives at Thankam's residence to collect the chit funds. In response, Thankam decides to assume Lilly's identity, informing the young woman that Thankam (who's actually Lily), has stepped out for an errand and will return late in the evening. However, the young woman insists on receiving the complete payment before leaving. How will Thankam manage to settle the total amount with the young woman? Stay tuned for further developments!

videos.title: A Big Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Ronald has noticed that in recent days, whenever Thambi, Sulu's husband, and Sufi, Mammootty's wife, leave the house, they engage in secret conversations. He communicates this observation to the other residents and subsequently informs Thambi and Sufi. How will they respond? What is the reality behind this? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Ronald Causes a Trouble Again
videos.overview: Thankam urged Ronald to promptly withdraw cash from the nearby ATM; however, Ronald was reluctant to undertake this task due to his aching legs. After considerable persuasion, he consented to go, opting to either take a rickshaw or use Kanakan's scooter. Initially, Lilly was hesitant to lend the scooter to Ronald, but she eventually relented after he assured her that he would not cause any damage. However, upon exiting the ATM, Ronald discovered the scooter lying on the roadside, resulting in minor damage. He reassured Lilly and Thankam that he would repair the scooter. Will he manage to finish this task before Kanakan returns? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus Gets Into Trouble
videos.overview: Cleatus is presented with an opportunity to appear on a news channel for a contentious debate against the opposition party, which had colluded with a road contractor responsible for a road accident due to negligence. However, he soon finds himself in a predicament upon discovering that the allegations he made against both the party and the contractor were unfounded. What will unfold next? Stay tuned for more details!

videos.title: The Story of the Marriage Ring
videos.overview: The ex-fiancé of Thankam, who was set to marry her, came to her home to reclaim the ring that her mother had given to her. Unfortunately, Thankam cannot remember where she had kept the ring. After extensive questioning from all the household members, Lilly proposes that Kanakan should inquire with Girirajan as well, believing he may have information regarding its whereabouts. What happens next? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: An Imposter in Disguise
videos.overview: One morning, Sufi's youngest sister, Surmi, arrives at Sufi's place to surprise her but instead got a surprise when she learnt that they aren't at home. Thankam calls her to her place to rest and wait till they come. Susbsequently, Lilly arrives and insisted her to stay at her place. Later, Thankam and Lilly leave for the Kudumbashree meeting (Ladies Meeting), leaving Takkuddu behind. When they came back, they found her to be missing. What happens next? Find out to know more!

videos.title: The Job as an Aanganwadi Helper
videos.overview: Both Girija and Thankam convey their eagerness to engage in work rather than idly spending their time after finishing household tasks. The following day, Thankam visits the Aanganwadi Centre for some work and is presented with an opportunity to serve as an Aanganwadi helper. She shares this news with Kanakan, anticipating that Cleatus would decline. Girija asserts that if Thankam is unable to accept the position, she is willing to take it, however, both of their husbands oppose this. Who will ultimately seize this opportunity? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Missing Induction Cooker
videos.overview: One morning, Sister Sulu approached Lilly to request a gas cylinder for cooking purposes. However, Lilly was unable to assist as her own gas cylinder was nearly empty. Instead, she lent Sister Sulu, Sufi's Induction Cooker to help her until a new gas cylinder could be obtained. Later, Sulu and Thambi returned to inform Lilly that the Induction Cooker had been stolen. Who could be responsible for the theft? How will Lilly explain this situation to Sufi? Tune in to discover the full story!

videos.title: The Friendly Avengers
videos.overview: Cleatus and Ronald informs the household members that two people were after them, and in order to save themselves from getting bashed up, they run for their lives, leaving the ladies and Takkuddu behind. After a while, the two men arrive in search of Cleatus. With Kanakan's absence, the ladies try to pacify the men to come back later as Cleatus was not there, but they resisted to stay back unless they teach Cleatus a lesson! How will the ladies manage to pacify the two men? Watch now to know the story!

videos.title: A Sip of Redemption for Thankam
videos.overview: The narrative commences with distressing news conveyed by Appu Kuttan Sir to Cleatus, informing him of Natarajan's sudden heart attack, which has left him on a ventilator in the hospital. Subsequently, Natarajan clarifies the situation. During this time, Lilly ridicules Thankam for never having offered even a cup of tea to Ansar and Natarajan during their visits to Cleatus. In an effort to counter Lilly's claim, Thankam extends an invitation for them to enjoy a cup of tea. Will Thankam resolve the dispute by disproving Lilly's assertion? Discover the outcome!

videos.title: Surmi Gets Blackmailed
videos.overview: The narrative commences with Surmi, the younger sister of Sufi, who is in a state of distress after being blackmailed by an individual. This person had spiked her drink, taken unauthorized photographs, and recorded videos of her, subsequently demanding money to prevent the release of this content on social media. Surmi was not in a suitable mental state to confide in Lilly and Thankam, prompting Sufi to inform them of the situation so that Kanakan could step in and provide assistance. How will Kanakan apprehend the perpetrator, ensure he faces consequences for his actions, and safeguard Surmi's dignity from being compromised? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Girija's Love for Poetry
videos.overview: The entire household appears taken aback by Girija's transformation, as she begins sharing poetry on social media. The following morning, Girirajan arrives, visibly concerned about Girija's abrupt change in behavior. What unfolds next? Discover the details!

videos.title: Why is Thankam Upset?
videos.overview: The narrative commences with Cleatus, Thankam, Takkuddu, and Lilly as they prepare to attend a wedding. Upon their return, Thankam appears to be distressed and is uncommunicative. What might be the cause of this demeanor? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Summer Camp
videos.overview: The narrative commences with Thankam expressing her frustration over the children constantly watching television. Upon abruptly turning it off, Takkuddu retaliates with a vulgar remark, inciting anger in her and others. The family resolves to send the children to a summer camp, but the kids refuse. What unfolds next? Discover the details!

videos.title: Ansar Gets a Second-Hand Car
videos.overview: The narrative commences as Ansar acquires a pre-owned vehicle and reaches Cleatus's home. Upon noticing the car, Kanakan ridicules Cleatus for lacking a vehicle. This provokes Cleatus, who, accompanied by Ronald, visits a second-hand car dealership to purchase a car. Will he succeed in buying a car and disproving Kanakan? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan Saves the Day
videos.overview: The story commences with Thankam waking up Takkuddu and sending him to the Summer Camp. Upon his return, Thankam notices that there are red marks on his hands. On questioning, Takkuddu makes excuses and walks away. Later, Thankam learns the truth and informs Lilly about it. Meanwhile Sulu informs Girirajan about this incident and decides to handle the situation. Will he succeed in fulfilling the task? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Thankam's Grand Pretence
videos.overview: Thankam and Cleatus gets involved in a fight where Thankam accuses Cleatus of abusing her physically. Everyone gets highly upset on knowing this and express their anger towards him. How will Cleatus save himself from everyone's wrath? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Frock Nighty
videos.overview: One morning, Girija Ammayi returns to Kanakan's place after attending the opening ceremony of her friend's store. On her way back, she had purchased three Frock Nighties for the ladies of the house, except for Ratnamma, which makes her feel sad and disappointed. Earlier, unaware of the reason behind her sadness, when Girija asked, Ratnamma opened up and expressed her desire for a Frock Nighty. Will the household members agree to buy one for her? Find out to know more!

videos.title: Cleatus Experiences Severe Itching
videos.overview: While traveling by bus to a party event in Kozhikode, Cleatus experiences severe itching. He decides to broadcast a live video to express his discomfort. However, he soon faces difficulties when his assertions are proven to be untrue. How will Cleatus extricate himself from this predicament? What might be the cause of his intense itching? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: Lilly is the Star
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly receives a phone call from Cleatus, who informs her of an opportunity to perform with her students at a nearby upcoming shoot. Seizing this chance, Lilly starts rehearsing the dance performance with her students. Will she achieve the recognition and fame she desires? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: A Dispute Between the Mother-In-Law and Daughter-In-Law
videos.overview: One morning, Sister Omana pays a visit to Ratnamma to inquire about her health. Following an extensive discussion, she encounters Lilly and incites her against Ratnamma by spreading negative remarks about her. Upon hearing this, Lilly becomes very distressed and confronts Ratnamma, leading to a conflict between them. How will their misunderstanding be uncovered? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: The Kids' Vishu Money
videos.overview: As is customary, Cleatus and Ronald find themselves in urgent need of funds. Subsequently, they discover that the children have not yet utilized the money they received during the Vishu Celebrations. The two devise a strategy to determine who will acquire the money. Who will emerge victorious? Read on to find out more!

videos.title: Girirajan's New Farm Helper - Part 1
videos.overview: This episode opens with Girirajan alerting Cleatus to the absence of his farm helper, who has also taken some money. The team heads to the Red Spinach farm in search of him, but to their disappointment, he is not found. After returning to Kanakan's home, Lilly and Thankam have a confrontation. Later, Girirajan gets a call from his missing farm helper. What unfolds in the next part? Keep watching to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan's New Farm Helper - Part 2
videos.overview: In the latter segment of this episode, Cleatus admonishes Kishanchand, the newly appointed Bengali farm assistant employed by Girirajan, for failing to inform everyone about his location. Subsequently, a small group of Bengali workers organizes a protest at the farm, prompting Girirajan and Cleatus to leave in order to address the situation, but they end up being captured. Where has Kishanchand disappeared to? What consequences will Girirajan and Cleatus face if he cannot be located? Discover more to find out!

videos.title: A Meeting of Love and Friendship
videos.overview: Cleatus, together with his DDT Party Members, has chosen to initiate a campaign with the assistance of the opposition party. Conversely, Shashi, the leader of the RDP Party and Cleatus's rival, is strategizing his own plans. Subsequently, at home, the children engage in a dispute among themselves, which is then joined by Thankam and Lilly. After addressing these issues, Girirajan receives a call informing him of Cleatus's arrest. What will transpire next? Stay tuned to discover more!

videos.title: Spilled Mustard: Sowing Seeds of Strife
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma was preparing a dish in the kitchen when she asked Lilly to hand her the mustard seeds. By mistake, Lilly dropped some mustard seeds on the floor. videos.title: Ronald's Pulikali Dilemma
videos.overview: One evening, Thambi offers Ronald a job to perform as the Pulikali, a traditional folk art form of Kerala where artists paint their bodies with yellow, red, and black stripes to mimic tigers and perform an energetic dance. Now, Ronald is faced with two job opportunities. Which one will he choose? Who will offer him better pay? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: An Eye for an Eye
videos.overview: One morning, Thambi approached Lilly to request a few dry coconut shells. Unfortunately, Lilly did not have any, so he turned to Thankam, from whom he managed to obtain a few. Later, it came to light that Thambi had sold the dry coconut shells to a junk dealer for a considerable amount of money. How will Thankam and Ronald teach him a lesson? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Clash at the Washing Stone
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly was washing her clothes but had to leave them behind as she was called away for urgent work. Later, Thankam moved Lilly's clothes aside and began washing her own. This action led to a disagreement between Lilly and Thankam when it was noticed. Who will mediate a resolution to their conflict? Will both parties find satisfaction in the outcome? Watch now to uncover the full story!

videos.title: Cleatus's Motivational Classes
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus found himself in urgent need of money and began reaching out to his friends for assistance. However, all of them subtly declined his requests. It was then that Ronald proposed an idea to Cleatus to start his own motivational classes and earn money from each session. Will this innovative plan lead to success or result in failure? Find out more by watching now!

videos.title: Lilly Suffers from a Severe Injury
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly and Kanakan returned home after attending a wedding, both harboring anger towards each other. In an attempt to gain Kanakan's attention, Lilly suffered a severe injury. Upon consulting a doctor, Kanakan received shocking news regarding her condition. How will Kanakan ensure Lilly's well-being and handle the financial burden of her medical treatment? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Gold Necklace
videos.overview: One morning, a husband and wife accuse their maid of stealing the wife's gold necklace, leading to her dismissal from the job. Meanwhile, Kanakan begins an investigation alongside Cleatus to uncover the truth behind the incident. Did the maid actually steal the gold necklace? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus's Flex Board Dilemma
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus feels a sense of pride when he notices his flex board displayed prominently by the roadside. However, later in the day, Kanakan receives strict instructions from his superiors to promptly remove all flex boards. Unfortunately, the individual responsible for installing Cleatus's flex board is unavailable to take it down. If Cleatus fails to ensure its removal before the stipulated deadline, he and his party will face a penalty in the form of a fine. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Love Letter for Cleatus
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam and the family receive an unexpected letter addressed to Cleatus. Upon opening it, they discover it is a love letter from an anonymous sender. The mystery deepens as they wonder who this secret admirer could be. Watch now to uncover the truth!

videos.title: Kanakan's Uniform
videos.overview: One morning, as Kanakan returns from his duty, he enters the house in complete silence. When questioned, Lilly explains that this behavior has been ongoing for several days and proceeds to narrate the entire story. After completing some household chores, Kanakan washes his uniform and hangs it out to dry. He assigns Ronald the responsibility of bringing the uniform inside before the rain starts, but Ronald fails to fulfill the task. What unfolds next? Watch now to discover more!

videos.title: Takkuddu and Saiyyu Falls into Trouble
videos.overview: One morning, Takkuddu and Saiyyu asked their parents for permission to accompany them to the residence of a deceased individual. Their request was firmly declined, as their parents believed that the children would not be able to manage themselves in such a situation. Ratnamma, Akshaya, Takkuddu, Nallu, and Saiyyu stayed behind, while the others left to pay their respects. Meanwhile, Takkuddu and Saiyyu found themselves in trouble after causing considerable difficulties for Ratnamma. What unfolds next? Tune in to find out more!

videos.title: Cleatus Messes with the Police
videos.overview: One morning, while Lilly, Thankam, and Aksaya were occupied with folding sarees after they had dried, Ronald approached them and recounted an incident involving a police officer and his team. They had given their police vehicle to Ronald for repair but left without settling the payment. Choosing not to approach Kanakan, Ronald turned to Cleatus, who decided to take matters into his own hands. What unfolds next? Discover the intriguing events that follow!

videos.title: An Unknown Bag of Money
videos.overview: One morning, while Cleatus was on his way home, he came across an unfamiliar bag lying by the roadside. Upon opening it, he discovered several bundles of cash inside. Overcome with excitement, Cleatus decided to keep the money for himself. However, that night and throughout the following day, he was plagued by an overwhelming fear of being discovered, as he had concealed this incident from everyone. This fear disrupted his peace of mind. What course of action will Cleatus ultimately choose? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Thankam Goes Viral
videos.overview: One morning, as Thankam and Sulochana were returning home, they noticed a red car parked near the entrance to their residence. Curious about the vehicle, Thankam approached it and found a young man and woman inside, engaged in conversation. Concerned by their presence, Thankam reprimanded them. In response, the pair recorded a video of the encounter, which they later uploaded to social media in an attempt to tarnish Thankam's reputation. What happens next? Tune in to find out more!

videos.title: Ronald's Troublesome Family
videos.overview: One morning, Ansar and Natarajan bring Ronald to Thankam's home after he sustains injuries. Concerned for his well-being and in need of someone to care for him, Thankam informs both Ronald's mother and his wife about his condition. However, their arrival marks the beginning of escalating troubles for Thankam and her entire family. What unfolds next? Watch now to discover more!

videos.title: The Mysterious & Ominous Phone Call
videos.overview: At midnight, Kanakan receives an anonymous call notifying him of someone's death, but before he can gather more details, the call abruptly ends. Lilly becomes increasingly worried, as her father had been complaining of chest pain just a few days prior. While the initial confusion eventually clears, the mystery lingers, haunting them. Determined to uncover the truth, everyone begins investigating the identity of the mysterious caller. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Omana's Attempt to Exact Revenge
videos.overview: One morning, Sister Omana set out to visit Thankam and Lilly but quickly concealed herself upon spotting Kanakan. Once he departed, she seized a chance to evade him but was apprehended and chastised by him for having caused discord within the family in the past. Deeply angered, Omana resolved to enact her revenge through Ronald. What unfolds next? Tune in to find out!

videos.title: Lallu's Closeness to Akshaya
videos.overview: One morning, Lallu notices Akshaya and Ratnamma on their way home. He asks Akshaya to accompany him while arranging for Ratnamma to be dropped off at her home on his friend's bike. However, Ratnamma refuses his suggestion and decides to walk home with Akshaya instead. Upon reaching home, Lallu seizes an opportunity to present Akshaya with a set of bangles as a gift, expressing his desire for her to wear them. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus's Friend Pays a Visit
videos.overview: One morning, Kanakan addresses everyone about Cleatus, a rare occurrence, as Cleatus had resolved a critical issue before Kanakan and his team even arrived, earning widespread admiration. The revelation left everyone in disbelief. The following day, Cleatus's friend, the very person Cleatus assisted, pays a visit. What unfolds next? Watch now to uncover the full story!

videos.title: An Unknown Parcel for Ronald
videos.overview: One morning, a delivery guy delivered Ronald's parcel to Kanakan's residence. The package had no details about the sender, and Ronald had no idea he was expecting a parcel. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Ronald's Ex-Lover Pays a Visit
videos.overview: One morning, an unfamiliar young woman arrived at Kanakan's residence seeking Ronald. None of the family members could recognize her until she introduced herself as Ronald's former lover. The revelation left everyone stunned, as they had not anticipated her visit so unexpectedly. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Ronald the Deceiver
videos.overview: One morning, as Akshaya and Ronald were scolding Takkuddu for his mischief, Thankam entered the scene, furious at Ronald for deceiving her friend. Her friend's husband had entrusted Ronald's shop with his bike for repairs, only to discover that old parts were installed instead of new ones, despite being charged for fresh replacements. Lilly, who was present, took Ronald with her, unable to endure the accusations Thankam hurled at him. Later, Lilly's friend visited her and shared her struggles, explaining how her vehicle was in poor condition. Lilly, in response, suggested Ronald's name for assistance. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Sewing Machine
videos.overview: One morning, Thambi informs Thankam and Lilly that Ronald is set to receive a sewing machine as a gift. Upon hearing this, Thankam and Lilly make every effort to charm and persuade Ronald in hopes of acquiring the sewing machine for themselves. What unfolds next? Tune in to find out more!

videos.title: Ratnamma's Stubbornness
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald keeps his promise and brings biriyani for everyone. Lilly serves the drumsticks to the children and carefully minces the chicken pieces for Ratnamma. Observing this, Ratnamma becomes upset with Lilly, feeling slighted for not being offered the drumsticks and for having her chicken minced without consultation. In response, Lilly requests Ronald to bring a few drumsticks for Ratnamma, who is being insistent. Once she receives them, Ratnamma enjoys the drumsticks heartily, but soon begins to choke as a bone becomes lodged in her throat. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Akshaya's Educational Expenses
videos.overview: Thankam has noticed a change in Akshaya's behavior. Whenever she attempts to ask if Akshaya is facing any issues, Akshaya responds with excuses and reassures her mother that there is nothing to worry about. One night, Thankam observed Akshaya holding a red diary in the dark, using her mobile's flashlight for illumination. Upon noticing her mother, Akshaya quickly concealed the diary, further intensifying Thankam's suspicions. What is Akshaya truly hiding? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Akshaya's Response Disheartens Cleatus
videos.overview: As Akshaya recently turned eighteen, the legal age to vote, Cleatus firmly believed that his daughter would support his political party. However, one morning, the opposition party leader, Shashi, along with his team, visited Cleatus's residence to meet Akshaya. They informed her about her rights and responsibilities as a voter, encouraging her to make an independent choice. Cleatus, who had been confidently proclaiming that his daughter would vote for his party, is taken aback by a statement she makes, leaving him deeply disheartened. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Rosemary's Job Interview
videos.overview: One morning, while Thankam and Ratnamma waited for Ronald and Akshaya to return from the butcher's shop, Rosemary and her mother-in-law arrived at their residence. When inquired about the reason for their visit, Rosemary revealed that she had an interview scheduled the next day for a position at a supermarket store. This announcement brought joy to everyone present. Stay tuned to discover the outcome!

videos.title: The Stylish Sporty Bike
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus acquires a stylish and sporty bike with the intention of selling it. The household members are thrilled upon seeing the sleek new bike, their excitement filling the air. However, that night, Cleatus receives a shocking phone call revealing that the bike had been sold twice before, and tragically, both previous owners perished in accidents while riding it. This unsettling news leaves everyone in the household deeply disturbed, and the tension escalates further with Thankam experiencing a terrifying nightmare. Will Cleatus manage to sell this bike at a profit despite its ominous history? Discover the answer to unravel this intriguing tale!

videos.title: Charity Worker Cleatus
videos.overview: Cleatus has taken up a charitable endeavor by assisting in the construction of a house for an elderly couple. Despite Thankam cautioning him against involving himself in unnecessary troubles due to his known antics, Cleatus disregards her advice. The following day, he procures several sacks of cement and other construction materials for his personal use from the same site where the house is being built for the elderly couple. What is Cleatus planning? Watch now to uncover the full story.

videos.title: The CCTV Footage
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus held a brief meeting with Ansar and Natarajan to discuss strategies for obtaining CCTV footage to seek justice for a party worker who tragically died while in custody. During the discussion, Cleatus cautioned Kanakan, warning him that if his face appeared in the CCTV footage, it could lead to serious trouble. However, Kanakan expressed strong confidence that he had no involvement in the matter. Cleatus's warning caused significant concern among everyone in the household. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Gemini Trend
videos.overview: One morning, Akshaya demonstrated to Lilly how she could transform ordinary pictures into AI-generated enhanced images. Enthralled by the idea, Lilly created one for herself, posted it on Facebook, and received an impressive 500 likes, quickly followed by Ronald and other household members trying it out. However, when it was Thankam's turn, the AI-generated image created for her was unappealing and deemed inappropriate by her. Upset, she hastily approached Lilly, leading to a tense confrontation between the two. What unfolds next? Watch now to discover the full story!

videos.title: Kanakan Saves Cleatus
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus approaches Thankam and Lilly, seeking financial assistance for a business investment. However, before they could provide their decision, Kanakan steps in and adamantly refuses to support him. Undeterred, Cleatus acquires a sample of the product with the aid of Natarajan. Subsequently, Cleatus uncovers a startling truth about the product. What unfolds next? Watch now to discover more!

videos.title: The Amoeba Mayhem
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam takes Akshaya to the hospital as she experiences nausea. Upon their return, Thankam informs Lilly and Ronald that her condition might be caused by the presence of amoeba in the well water she consumes. The families decide to undertake the task of eliminating the amoeba from the well using the chlorination process. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Leaving the Village
videos.overview: At midnight, Cleatus, Ronald, and Girirajan leave their homes without notifying anyone. By the following morning, their disappearance prompts an extensive search. After multiple attempts to reach them, Girirajan finally answers Kanakan's call and reveals their location. What compelled them to leave their homes? Watch now to uncover the full story!

videos.title: The Unique Lottery Scheme
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald came up with a plan to gather money from everyone to buy lottery tickets and see who might win. Everyone loved his idea and eagerly gave him money for the tickets. What happens next? Watch now to know more!

When Girija requested the astrologer to read Girirajan's future, he disclosed an unfulfilled love story from Girirajan's past life. Hearing this, Girirajan felt a deep sense of happiness, but it left Girija feeling unhappy. What happens next? Watch now to find out!
