videos.title: A Stalker Troubles Lilly
videos.overview: One morning, while Lilly was waiting for Thankam at the bus stop, a man approached her to discuss enrolling his daughter in her dance class. Later, he began texting and calling Lilly, leaving her feeling stressed and uncomfortable. Noticing the change in Lilly’s behavior, Thankam confronts her to understand what’s going on. What will Thankam do next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan's Digital Arrest
videos.overview: One morning, Girirajan arrives at Kanakan's residence after a heated argument with Girija at home. Girija, upset, calls Thankam to share the reason behind the argument, and they too side with Girija, confronting Girirajan for his behavior. Things take a turn when Girirajan's actions land him in trouble, resulting in a digital arrest. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Rosemary Wants to Go Shopping
videos.overview: One morning, Rosemary asks Ronald for some money to buy clothes for a relative's upcoming wedding. As usual, Ronald is short on cash and refuses, leaving Rosemary upset and wanting to return home in anger and disappointment. How will Ronald win her over? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Aunt Sini's Visit
videos.overview: At midnight, Kanakan receives a call from Aunt Sini, informing him of her arrival the next day. She arrives as planned and brings gifts for everyone. Lilly distributes the gifts among herself, Thankam, and Girija. However, when Thankam visits, she notices the gifts weren't distributed fairly, as Lilly kept the items, she wanted for herself. Frustrated and disappointed by Lilly's stubborn behavior, Thankam leaves in anger. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan Gets Arrested
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus tasks Ronald with organizing the arrangements for Natarajan's relative's funeral. Cleverly, he invites Girirajan to accompany him for assistance. On the way, Ronald stops at a store to drop off a mixer for repair, leaving Girirajan behind. When he returns, he realizes Girirajan has vanished. Where could he have gone? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus's Spying Gone Wrong
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus had a heated argument with Thambi after being insulted in front of someone behind his back. Later, Cleatus spots Thambi with a girl at the beach, secretly records it, and shows the footage to the family members and Sulochana. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Rosemary's Hidden Agenda
videos.overview: One morning, Rosemary pays a visit to Ronald. Initially, Ronald assumes she might be there to ask for some money, but this time her purpose is entirely different. In fact, her demeanor towards everyone, including Ronald, has undergone a remarkable transformation—from being irritating and confrontational to becoming pleasant, composed, and serene. This unexpected change in her behavior has left everyone astonished. What could be the underlying reason for this transformation? Tune in now to discover more!

videos.title: Thankam's New Business Venture
videos.overview: One morning, inspired by a reel she watched, Thankam decides to turn her dream into reality by launching her own designer clothing brand. With everyone rallying behind her new venture, the question remains — will her business reach the heights she envisions? Tune in now to find out!

videos.title: When Kindness Backfires
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam shared a couple's photo in several WhatsApp groups, only to realize later that it was an AI-generated image sent by Omana. Things took a turn when the girl's mother confronted Thankam, threatening to file a police complaint since Thankam had no evidence to prove Omana sent her the photo, as it had been deleted for everyone. But that's not the end of the story! There's more to uncover—watch now to find out!

videos.title: Ronald Gives a Rose to a Lady
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald and Takkuddu were heading home when Takkuddu spotted a rose on the roadside and handed it to Ronald, who then gave it to a little girl. The girl hesitated to accept the rose, so her mother took it instead, sparking chaos at Kanakan's residence. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Ratnamma Gets Annoyed With Ronald's Mother
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald tried to avoid facing Ratnamma, but she noticed and called out to him, asking about the money she had lent him. As usual, Ronald came up with excuses, doing his best to calm her down. Just then, Ronald's mother stepped in, sparking a heated argument between her and Ratnamma. What happens next? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus's Foolishness
videos.overview: One morning, a rag picker stopped by Cleatus's place to collect scrap items. Along with the scrap, Cleatus asked him to take some old clothes as well. The rag picker mentioned they wouldn’t be of any use, but Cleatus insisted he take them anyway. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan Gets Drugged
videos.overview: One morning, Girirajan turned away a door-to-door salesman who had arrived at Thankam's home to sell products. Later, the others left without him to visit Ronald's relative. Upon their return, they found Girirajan lying unconscious in front of Kanakan's house. What exactly transpired? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus the Whistleblower
videos.overview: One morning, when Cleatus wasn’t making enough money working for his party, Ansar suggested that he become a whistleblower. As soon as Cleatus shared his decision, almost everyone opposed it—except for Kanakan, who surprisingly supported him and assured everyone that his personal information would remain strictly confidential. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan Gets Blamed
videos.overview: One morning, Girirajan and Girija hurried over to Kanakan's place. Everyone noticed that Girirajan looked upset. When they asked why, he explained that he was being blamed for someone else's mistake. What really happened? And what unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Brother-in-Law and Sister-in-Law
videos.overview: One morning, Ansar brings a man to Cleatus seeking help with a problem. Cleatus promises to take care of it but demands payment in return. Believing the job will be done, the man hands over the money. Later, Suresh calls Kanakan to tell him about Cleatus’s actions. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Ronald the Matchmaker
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald revealed his new business idea as a matchmaker to everyone, but only Cleatus supported him while the rest weren’t convinced. To everyone’s surprise, he soon announced the good news of arranging a marriage alliance and even brought food for all. Will his business take off? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Ronald's Pretence
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald pretends to have lost his memory after a coconut falls on his head. Everyone rallies around, trying to help him remember. But why is Ronald putting on this act? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Kanakan's Intervention
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma’s friend stops by to talk about the issues she’s facing with her son and daughter-in-law. Ratnamma then tells Kanakan about it, hoping he can help resolve the situation. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Deja Vu
videos.overview: One morning, Kanakan, Lilly, Thankam, and Takkuddu were getting ready to head out. Around the same time, after taking her syrup medicine, Ratnamma suddenly had a disturbing vision of the four meeting with an accident—a piece of news she imagined hearing from Ronald. The thought left her deeply shaken. Later, Thankam and Takkuddu arrived at Kanakan’s place, ready to leave and waiting for Kanakan and Lilly, which only heightened her fear. Will Ratnamma’s vision come true? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Storm in the Teacup
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly is thrilled to think that everyone in the house is planning a surprise birthday party for her, only to later find out it was all a misunderstanding, leaving her feeling deeply sad. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Thankam Injures Ronald's Eye
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam and Lilly were engaged in conversation while Akshaya served tea to Cleatus and Girirajan. Later, they all began eating some grated coconut placed on a plate at the dining table. Upon returning, Thankam noticed Ronald finishing it and, in a moment of anger, threw the grated coconut at his face. She soon realized she had accidentally injured his eye. The others scolded her for her actions, leaving her saddened and deeply regretful, holding herself responsible for Ronald’s injury. What happens next? Watch now to find out more.

videos.title: Kanakan Falls Into Trouble
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald shared news from the newspaper about some stolen items that had been seized by the police but were later sold by them. Kanakan made a joke about it to Ronald, but Ronald took it seriously. Soon after, Kanakan was summoned by his senior over the matter. Suspicion fell on Cleatus, as he had told Lilly and Thankam that he would get back at Kanakan in this way. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Haldi Ceremony
videos.overview: One morning, Akshaya, Lilly, and Thankam were all set to attend Akshaya’s friend’s Haldi ceremony when they realized everyone was expected to wear matching yellow outfits. Only Akshaya had the right outfit, while the others didn’t. They decided to skip the event, but Thankam and Lilly encouraged Akshaya to go anyway. However, she didn’t feel like attending without her family. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Ronald's Health Concerns
videos.overview: Ronald had been feeling unwell with a fever since morning and stayed in bed. Later, everyone urged him to visit the hospital. When he returned, they were stunned to hear that the doctors had recommended a diagnostic test for RCC (Renal Cell Carcinoma) due to their suspicions. The news left everyone in shock and deeply saddened. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Counselling For Kanakan and Lilly
videos.overview: When Ronald arrives at Kanakan’s place, he notices that Kanakan and Lilly have once again gotten into an argument. He quickly informs Cleatus and Thankam, who arrange a counseling session for the two. However, before the counselors arrive, Kanakan and Lilly manage to work things out on their own. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Role for the Queen
videos.overview: One morning, Thambi visits Kanakan’s home to ask if the women of the house are interested in auditioning for the role of the Queen in his new drama. Kanakan encourages him to let them try and see who fits the part best. Later, Thambi approaches Omana, invites her to take on the role, and she gladly agrees. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: The Grandmother's Worry
videos.overview: One evening, while Ratnamma was asleep, she dreamt of a boy coming to meet Akshaya late at night, only to find her fast asleep. Ratnamma noticed and tried to step in, but the boy suddenly lunged at her with a knife, attacking her. The terrifying dream left Ratnamma shaken. The next day, she read a news story about a boy and girl eloping at night. Disturbed by this, she began acting strictly with Akshaya, determined to keep her under control. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Arvind the Unexpected Guest
videos.overview: One morning, as Kanakan was running late and about to leave, his former senior, Arvind, showed up at his house for a chat. Even after Kanakan explained he was late for work, Arvind urged him to stay longer, saying it had been years since they last met. Before long, Arvind’s presence began to bother everyone, prompting Kanakan to hide from him. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Trip to Sabarimala
videos.overview: One evening, as Ratnamma slept, she dreamed of Lord Ayyappa Swami appearing and blessing her. Overwhelmed with joy, she told Kanakan about her wish to visit the Sabarimala temple. Soon after, Takkuddu decided to join them too. But just before they could begin their journey, an unforeseen and sorrowful event occurred. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Elections - Part 1
videos.overview: Election season is in full swing in Kerala, and Cleatus along with his DDT party is hitting the campaign trail, urging people to cast their votes in their favour. What’s next? Tune in to find out!

videos.title: The Elections - Part 2
videos.overview: Previously, Ansar received a call informing Cleatus that no male members could run in the elections, but female members were eligible. Ansar proposed Thankam’s name, but Cleatus rejected the idea, convinced his household wouldn’t support their party. Later, at the party office, following the members’ suggestions and enthusiasm, everyone agreed to put forward Ansar’s wife as the candidate. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: The Elections - Part 3
videos.overview: Earlier, everyone at the DDT Party Office backed Ansar’s wife to contest in the elections on behalf of their party. Later, Kanakan tried calling Cleatus to check on him, but he didn’t answer. He then called Ansar, who told him Cleatus wouldn’t be running in the elections. Assuming it was Ansar again this time, Thankam created a video accusing the party of cheating Cleatus. The video quickly went viral, reaching millions, and Pooradan Shashi from the opposition saw an opportunity to use it to their advantage. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Elections - Part 4
videos.overview: Earlier, Thankam and Kanakan comforted Cleatus and brought him home. Soon after, Pooradan Shashi and his party members arrived at Cleatus’s house, asking Thankam to run in the elections as their female candidate. When Cleatus hears this, he becomes furious. While everyone tries to calm him down, Kanakan urges Thankam to contest the elections under the RDP Party banner. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Elections - Part 5
videos.overview: In this episode, Thankam keeps working tirelessly for the RDP Party as planned, while Cleatus and his party members go door-to-door seeking votes. Later, when the election results are announced, a shocking revelation shakes both Kanakan's and Cleatus's families to their core. What happens next? Tune in to find out!

videos.title: Post the Election Results
videos.overview: In the previous episode, it’s revealed that Thankam has won the elections. However, it wasn’t a happy moment for Thankam as their plan had failed, while Cleatus was deeply disheartened after losing to the RDP Party. Later, Akshaya prepared to leave for her hostel, leaving everyone teary-eyed. Watch now to find out more!

videos.title: Thankam's First Day as a Party Member
videos.overview: On her first day as a party member, Thankam is thrilled to enjoy the perks but keeps it under wraps from Cleatus, who still resents her victory over his party in the elections. When she receives an invitation to an event and shares it with everyone, Cleatus’s displeasure only grows. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Thankam's Accession
videos.overview: Thankam continues to enjoy the perks of being a victorious party member, frequently invited to various events, much to Cleatus’s jealousy. This time, it’s her turn to deliver a speech. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Thankam the Party Member
videos.overview: Thankam constantly boasts about being a party member, which irritates Cleatus. Kanakan steps in, trying to convince Cleatus to appreciate and support his wife’s good deeds. Later, two men show up at Thankam’s house. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Beyond the Call, Beyond the Reach
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald, Ansar, and Natarajan set out on a task. Later, Thankam and Lilly were on their way back home when they ran into Murali, who shared a problem with Thankam, hoping she could help. She assured him she would do her best. Meanwhile, Ansar arrived at Kanakan’s residence to tell Lilly that Ronald and Natarajan had been arrested. With Cleatus away, who will step in to free them? Watch now to find out!1

videos.title: Ronald's Accident
videos.overview: One morning, after a brief chat with Murali, Ronald left for work but met with an accident on the way. Murali and a few others hurried to the scene and brought him back home. Kanakan senses that something isn’t right. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Ronald and Thankam's Challenge
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald went to the kitchen for his tea and snacks but accidentally dropped the coconut oil. He made a bet with Thankam that he would get one litre of coconut oil before the day ended. Will he manage to win the challenge? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Problems and Problems
videos.overview: One morning, Girija gets ready to head to the hospital to visit Girirajan, who has been admitted there. Thankam decides to tag along, but they only have a single visitor pass that allows just one person inside. Confidently, Thankam assures everyone she’ll be allowed in without a pass since she’s now a party member. However, things take an unexpected turn when she ends up in a scuffle with a hospital security guard, leaving him injured. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Merry Christmas
videos.overview: This year, to make Christmas extra fun, the kids decided to play the popular game "Secret Santa" with everyone in the household joining in. Let’s find out how the game turns out. Watch now to learn more!

videos.title: Ward Member Thankam to the Rescue
videos.overview: One morning, a man approached Sulu asking for Thambi, wanting to get back the money he had lent him. Sulu explained that her husband wasn’t home and had gone out. After threatening Sulu, the man left. Later, Thambi and Sulu went to Thankam for help. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The BPL Card
videos.overview: One morning, Pooradan Shashi promises a couple that he’ll get things sorted and help them secure a BPL Card (Below Poverty Line Card). However, to make this happen, they need Thankam’s approval. So, Pooradan Shashi and the man visit Thankam’s residence to request her assistance in getting the card for the couple. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Lilly the Judge
videos.overview: One morning, a man and a woman approached Lilly with an offer to be a judge for a dance performance. Though she wasn’t prepared for it, Thankam insisted, and they asked for some time to decide. Later, Kanakan, Thankam, and Ronald encouraged her to seize the opportunity. After a while, Cleatus also urged her to accept the role, hoping to get his own work done through her. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Yellow Card
videos.overview: One morning, while Ratnamma was reading the newspaper, she saw her friend Devaki heading toward Thankam’s house. Curious, Ratnamma called out to ask why she was visiting. Devaki explained to both Ratnamma and Thankam that she needed a yellow card since she was no longer living with her son and required it to meet her basic needs. Thankam reassured her that she would take care of it. Meanwhile, Lilly shared her wish to become a ward member, just like Thankam, along with Ronald and Kanakan. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The New Year Celebrations
videos.overview: As the new year begins, everyone hopes 2026 will be filled with happiness, fresh opportunities, and joy. But the morning takes an unexpected turn when Kanakan and Cleatus get into a fight over a newspaper. The incident leaves everyone upset, especially Ratnamma, who decides to head to her ancestral home. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Shukran
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald’s friend was on his way to see him after a long time. Meanwhile, Cleatus kept ignoring a phone call, which Thankam suspected might be from one of the money lenders he owed. Later, Ronald brought his friend to Cleatus’s home. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Worker
videos.overview: One morning, after a quick chat with Ansar, Ronald heads to his workshop, only to be met by the shop owner asking for the rent. Short on cash, the owner decides to shut the place down. Just then, Kanakan steps in, calming the situation and assuring the owner that Ronald will pay the rent soon. That’s when Kanakan comes up with a brilliant idea. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Confusion
videos.overview: One morning, while Lilly and Thankam were chatting, Ronald arrived and told Lilly he had met a woman asking about Kanakan. When he offered to take her to his house, she hesitated and walked away, subtly prompting Lilly to suspect her husband. When Kanakan returned, the couple got into a heated argument. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: What's With This Attitude, Dear Policeman?
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald was seated outside as Kanakan, running late for work, prepared his scooter to leave. Unfortunately, the scooter failed to start. Before Kanakan could seek Ronald’s assistance, Ronald left the scene. After repeated calls from Kanakan, Lilly, and Thankam went unanswered and Ronald did not attend to the issue, Kanakan grew increasingly agitated and resolved to have the scooter repaired by a third party. What unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus's Heart
videos.overview: One morning, a man approaches Cleatus and Ansar, complaining about his problem and demanding his money back if they can’t complete his task. Cleatus and Ansar, however, trick him with their words and walk away. Later, the man goes to Shashi and tells him about Thankam’s broken promises. Soon after, Shashi criticizes Thankam for failing in her duties and commitments. She then returns home and speaks with Kanakan, who offers her comfort. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: The Senior Citizens' Gathering
videos.overview: One morning, as Takkuddu was getting ready for school, Thankam received a call from Shashi about an upcoming Senior Citizens' gathering featuring singing and dancing. She discussed it with Lilly, suggesting Ratnamma’s name for the dance. But will Ratnamma agree? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Guppy Fish
videos.overview: Ronald has an idea to start a business selling guppy fish to kids who love having them at home. He asks Thankam for a loan to get started, but everyone except Kanakan raises their hand, choosing not to support him. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Hunger Strike
videos.overview: Thankam, Cleatus, and Kanakan headed off to work, leaving Lilly and Ratnamma at home. As they busied themselves with chores in the backyard, a sudden argument erupted between them. Even though Lilly had promised Thankam she would cook, she and Ratnamma decided to skip making any food and go on a hunger strike instead. What happens next? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: A Trip to Paithalmala
videos.overview: Lilly and her colleague invited all the parents of the children from her dance class to help decide a destination for a short trip. Each parent shared their own suggestions, but later Lilly proposed visiting Paithalmala in Kannur. Everyone loved the idea, as they had never heard of the place and were excited to explore somewhere new. As Lilly was leaving her class for home, she noticed one couple talking, the husband repeatedly trying to convince his wife not to join the trip out of love and concern. Amused, Lilly tried the same with Kanakan, but he immediately gave her permission to go. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Prize Coupons
videos.overview: Takkuddu was given a school task to sell as many lucky coupons as he could for ₹10 each. He first approached Ronald, but Ronald couldn’t buy one since he didn’t even have ₹10 on him. To Takkuddu’s delight, Cleatus bought 10 coupons, making for a perfect start to his day. Later, when he met a stranger, Takkuddu asked if he’d like to buy some, and the man purchased five. But the story doesn’t end there—there’s a twist waiting to unfold. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Help for Thankam
videos.overview: One morning, an angry Lilly went to meet Thankam to confront her. The situation so heated that Thankam decided she wouldn’t accept any help from Lilly, even after Lilly chose to let the matter go. Later, Lilly received a call from Ronald, who told her that Thankam had been in a minor accident and could no longer walk properly. When Lilly offered to help, Thankam refused and instead contacted Shashi to arrange for a domestic worker to assist her until she recovers. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Business Loan
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald shares with Lilly his plan to shut down his garage and launch a fresh fruit juice business. To turn his dream into reality, he needs financial support. Lilly, hesitant to help because of her fear of Kanakan, points him toward Thankam, now the Ward Member, who might be able to lend a hand. Will Thankam step in to support Ronald? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Case of Theft
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam was preparing to attend a funeral with a death wreath bearing her party’s name. But as soon as she stepped outside, the wreath had vanished. Cleatus had a similar wreath design, but with his party’s name on it. Both Thankam and Cleatus insist the wreath belongs to their own party. So, who’s the thief? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Grand Feast
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma craved some delicious Pazhampoori (fried banana fritters). She first asked Thankam to make them, but the plan fell through as Thankam has to attend an urgent party meeting. Next, she turned to Lilly, but Lilly refused as she had a dance class to conduct. So, who will fulfill Ratnamma’s craving? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Another Saree Issue Again
videos.overview: One morning, Takkuddu discovers a saree belonging to an unknown woman, packed in a bag on Cleatus's shelf. An enraged Thankam lashes out at Cleatus, and in her agitation, burns the saree. Later, they learn it was Ambily’s, the housemaid who had once helped Thankam when she sprained her leg. How will they deal with this twist? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Wedding Mayhem
videos.overview: One morning, Takkuddu came down with a high fever. Thankam decided to put her party activities on hold for the day. Meanwhile, Ratnamma mentioned she had to attend a wedding. Later, Thankam received a call from her party asking her to attend an urgent meeting she couldn’t miss. She asked Ratnamma to look after him until she got back, but Ratnamma declined as she was running late. Who will take responsibility? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Life Mission
videos.overview: One morning, a couple visited Thankam’s home. Grateful for her help in completing their work, they offered her some money as a token of appreciation. But Thankam, being a responsible and honest party member, refused to accept it. Meanwhile, Ronald, always in need of money, seized the opportunity and borrowed it from them. When Cleatus found out, he scolded Ronald. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Problem of Gold Ornaments
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly receives a bill reminding her about the gold bangles she had pawned for some quick cash. She kept the reason a secret, until Thankam discovered it was for Ronald. Before Kanakan finds out, how will Ronald manage to get the gold ornaments back? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Importance of Wives
videos.overview: One morning, the ladies of the house head out for some work, planning to return in a day or two. The husbands take over household duties, brimming with confidence that they can handle everything without their wives. But what unfolds next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Small Argument
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly spoke poorly about Thankam to a couple visiting her place while Thankam was away. When Thankam returned, the couple mocked her, which made her furious. Upset, both decided not to speak to each other until one of them apologized. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: The Neglect
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly, Thankam, and Ratnamma were working in the backyard. Lilly had to leave partway through, and when she got home, she found her kids playing around with coconut oil. Furious, she chased after them to give them a scolding, but the kids hid behind Ratnamma and accidentally pushed her, causing her to fall to the ground. She cried out for help, but Lilly didn’t hear her. A short while later, Thankam noticed and took Ratnamma to her house. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Saviour
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly was making fish curry. She set the fish aside and went to the washing stone to do her laundry. Later, Thankam arrived to see if Lilly had dried Cleatus’s shirt, which she hadn’t, sparking a heated argument. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan's Time Is Up
videos.overview: One morning, Girirajan, Ratnamma, Thankam, and Lilly were working in the backyard. Later, Girirajan left, asking Lilly to wake him up at exactly 4 in the afternoon as he had somewhere to go. But after a while, he woke up early, only to realize he was dead, with his soul wandering around the house. What happened? Who’s responsible? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: An Opportunity for a Trip to Dubai
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam asked Lilly to perform a dance for the minister. The next day, Thambi met her at dance class with an offer to perform in Dubai. Without a second thought, Lilly agreed. This news left Thankam fuming. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The SI Test
videos.overview: After finishing his Sub-Inspector's Recruitment Test, Kanakan confronts Cleatus for failing to repay the money he borrowed from Girish. Later, Lallu visits Akshaya, surprising her with an ice cream. Meanwhile, Lilly steps in to help Cleatus arrange the cash. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Lizard Astrology
videos.overview: One morning, just as Thankam was about to serve Ronald some chicken curry, she spotted a dead lizard in it. Later, Lilly and Girija asked about the incident. Lilly revealed that a few days earlier, while making sambhar, a dead lizard had fallen into hers as well. Girija suggested performing a ritual, suspecting it might be a curse or something unusual. That’s when a quirky solution emerged to break the curse. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: What is Daddy's Job?
videos.overview: One morning, while Cleatus was running late for work, Takkuddu asked him a question that completely threw him off and left him stunned. Without uttering a word, he walked away. Later, Thambi tells Thankam about Cleatus’s odd behavior, as if he’s unwell or deeply troubled. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Kattayappam
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma was talking about a delicacy her son loved as a child—Kattayappam. The kids immediately said they wanted some. They asked Lilly to make it, but she had never heard of the dish and didn’t know how to prepare it. Then they turned to Thankam, who also refused, saying it was too difficult to make. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan Goes Missing
videos.overview: After a heated argument with Girija, Girirajan seeks support from Ratnamma. However, when everyone blames him for the conflict, he leaves in a state of distress. His sudden disappearance leaves the family worried and searching for answers. What happened to Girirajan? Watch now to find out.

videos.title: The Surprise Gift
videos.overview: While Sulochana, Thankam, and Ratnamma are catching up, a parcel arrives for Lallu. Busy with her plans to head out, Sulochana asks Thankam to hold onto the delivery. However, when Sulochana later mentions the arrival to Lallu, he reveals that the package is actually intended for Akshaya. What happens next? Watch the full episode to find out!

videos.title: Manthodi Appunni Pays a Visit
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma eagerly awaited her pension to be credited to her account. A short while later, Appunni uncle arrived with Cleatus at Kanakan’s place. Seeing him, Ratnamma hid her dislike and put on a pleasant face. But once he left, she vented her anger, insisting that his presence in the house would bring trouble for everyone. Soon enough, a series of misfortunes began. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Whose Fault Is It?
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus was chatting with Thambi. After Thambi left, Cleatus heard a loud crash of breaking glass. Following the noise to the kitchen, he found Thankam cleaning up the shattered remains of a glass jar, with pickles scattered across the floor. Furious, Cleatus scolded her and demanded she replace the pickles from wherever she could. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Who Will Support Thankam?
videos.overview: One morning, while Kanakan, Ronald, and Lilly were working in the backyard, Kanakan accidentally injured his leg and started bleeding. He was quickly rushed to the hospital. Shortly after his return, a man arrived at Thankam’s place and insulted her for not fulfilling her duties as a Ward Member. No one stood up for Thankam, leaving her deeply upset. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The God Helped Me Out
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam and Cleatus got into an argument when Thankam scolded Cleatus for neglecting his household chores. Upset, Cleatus stormed off and didn’t come back that night. By early morning, Kanakan received shocking news. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Ravan of Politics
videos.overview: One morning, a man approached Thankam for help with a property dispute. As a ward member, she assured him that she and her party would do everything they could to assist. Later, another man came to Cleatus with a similar issue. Soon, they discovered that both men were neighbors claiming rights to the same disputed land. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Good Behaviour
videos.overview: One morning, Girirajan grew irritated with his farm worker, who ignored his instructions while being absorbed in his phone, earphones plugged in. At the same time, Ronald’s careless behavior frustrated Cleatus. That’s when Girirajan decided to solve the problem by putting Ronald to work in his field to fill in for the absent workers. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Anklets
videos.overview: One morning, Takkuddu sat quietly in a corner. When Ronald came over to check on him, he admitted he was feeling bored and wanted to do something fun. That’s when Ronald had a quirky idea — to hide Lilly’s anklets. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Department of Child Welfare
videos.overview: Cleatus blames Thankam for neglecting Takkuddu, prompting Thankam to hand over Takkuddu’s responsibilities to him. Will Cleatus rise to the challenge? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Gospel of Luke
videos.overview: One evening, Kanakan gives Ratnamma an important document, asking her to pass it to Girirajan the next day. The following morning, after visiting the home of a deceased member, Girirajan arrives to see Ratnamma. She warns him not to enter the house until she sprinkles water on him, but distracted by a phone call, he walks in anyway. This angers Ratnamma, and in her frustration, she refuses to give him the document. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan's Smart Move
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus decided to temporarily move his party office to his home due to ongoing work at the original location. This decision didn’t sit well with everyone. When questioned about who gave him permission to set up, he pointed to Girirajan. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Mithika
videos.overview: One evening, Sulochana visits Akshaya, who has just returned from her hostel. The next day, Lilly and Thankam spot Lallu with a girl riding on his sports bike, heading towards their home. When Ronald checks, he finds out the girl, Mithika, is Lallu’s girlfriend. Hearing this, Akshaya feels insecure. How will she respond? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Soul with Ratnamma
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma prepares to visit the mourning house of her late friend. Ronald warns her that the departed soul will always stay by their loved one’s side. Though unsettled, she still goes. On her way back, she’s seen speaking to someone who isn’t actually there. Could Ronald’s warning have come true? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Loudspeaker
videos.overview: One morning, while returning to Kanakan’s place, Girirajan and Girija take a detour as Girirajan tries to avoid being spotted by someone. He later admits that he had promised the temple authorities he would arrange permission to use the loudspeaker through Kanakan’s help. However, he fails to keep his promise. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Solving the Problem
videos.overview: One day, Takkuddu’s school teacher visits Kanakan’s home, but finding him absent, she heads to Cleatus’s place instead. There, she explains her reason for wanting to meet Kanakan, hoping for help with her problem. That’s when Ronald steps in, determined to prove his worth and show his efforts are just as valuable as Kanakan’s. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Live Life Like a Kite
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly’s friend drops by for a visit and begins sharing her carefree lifestyle, living freely without ambitions or goals. She then attempts to discipline the male members of the family and influence Lilly and Girija with her ideas on leading a peaceful, relaxed life. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Night Watchguards
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam gets a call from someone complaining about stray dogs causing a nighttime disturbance. Seizing the chance to prove himself and boost the party’s reputation, Cleatus ropes in Ronald and Girirajan for the mission. Will they pull it off? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: From Zero to Hero
videos.overview: One evening, as soon as Ronald arrives at Kanakan's place, Ratnamma calls him over and urges him to return her gold chain that he had mortgaged, as quickly as possible. Later, Lilly also pleads with Ronald to return the chain, warning that otherwise she will have to endure constant taunts directed at her family. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Ring's Obsession
videos.overview: One morning, while the ladies were chatting, Lilly mentioned to Takkuddu that his grandmother would buy him a ring. From that moment, he kept following them around, asking for the ring. However, due to a lack of funds, they almost decided to cancel the plan until Sulu stepped in to help. Later, they invited her to join them for a temple procession. Unfortunately, as Thankam and Lilly were running late to the temple, they forgot to call Sulu, leaving her feeling sad and upset. How will the ladies win her over? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Knowledge and Ignorance
videos.overview: One morning, as the family was deep in conversation, Ronald spotted a woman heading toward Thankam’s house. Recognizing her, Thankam initially tried to avoid her but quickly gave up. The woman came to Thankam seeking help to mediate an argument with her husband, explaining that she wanted a divorce because she could no longer tolerate him. How will Thankam deal with this? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Wife's Fear
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly and Thankam were chatting about a couple’s married life, specifically how the husband was afraid of his wife. In the middle of their conversation, they sensed someone’s presence and assumed it must be Girirajan, since no one else was in the house. But when they found him fast asleep, they realized it couldn’t be him. That’s when the real story kicks off. Watch now to find out more!

videos.title: The New Workshop
videos.overview: One morning, while the family was chatting, Girirajan joined in to find out why Ronald was working in someone else’s shop. Watching him work so hard made Girirajan emotional and worried, prompting him to learn the true reason from the family. Later that evening, a tipsy Girirajan and Ronald returned home, and Girirajan promised Ronald that he would buy him a workshop, covering all the costs himself. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Fun Challenges
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly comes home only to be disappointed that Kanakan hasn’t completed the few household chores she assigned him. When she asks Ratnamma about it, she learns that Ratnamma tried her best to get him to finish the tasks but couldn’t succeed. That’s when Ratnamma hatches a clever plan to get the chores done quickly and smartly. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan's Love Story
videos.overview: One morning, Girija noticed that Girirajan had received a few messages from a woman. When she asked to see his phone, he refused. This made Girija suspect that he might be involved in an extramarital affair. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Kanakan Gets Promoted to SI
videos.overview: One morning, a nervous Kanakan awaited the announcement of his SI Exam results. Later, he got a phone call telling him he had passed and was officially promoted to Sub Inspector. The news everyone had been hoping for over so many years had finally become a reality.

videos.title: The Change
videos.overview: While everyone was celebrating Kanakan’s promotion to SI, some bad news surfaced. Cleatus, who had been hiding the fact that he was temporarily removed from the party, suddenly found himself in the spotlight. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus's New Business
videos.overview: One morning, after much thought, Cleatus decides to start his own business — We Help! An organization dedicated to looking after people’s welfare and solving everyday problems. He asks his family members to get ready for the inaugural ceremony of his new venture. He also mentions that someone important will be attending the event. Who could it be? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Labour Dispute
videos.overview: One morning, Girirajan asked Cleatus to find a laborer to work on his farm. Later, when Girirajan checked in for an update, Cleatus admitted he hadn’t managed to find anyone yet but was doing his best to get it done. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Girirajan Goes Viral
videos.overview: One morning, while Ratnamma was upset with Girirajan, Cleatus arrived with some good news. He revealed that Girirajan had done such a great job that he was receiving praise online from netizens. However, when Kanakan heard about it, instead of showing support, he reacted with displeasure and voiced his dissatisfaction, leaving Girirajan feeling disheartened. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Financial Loss
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus was considering buying a second-hand scooter. That’s when Ronald suggested, why bother buying one when there’s already a scooter right in front of him — Kanakan’s! Ronald explained that ever since he became the SI, he rarely uses his scooter, so Cleatus could use it for traveling. Will Kanakan agree? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Test Within A Test
videos.overview: One morning, Girirajan noticed a distressed Akshaya on her way back from the hostel. When he asked her what was wrong, she confessed that she had skipped her lecture to watch a movie with friends, only to be caught by her friend's mother. Everyone had been eagerly waiting for Akshaya, but as soon as she stepped into her house, the conversation stopped, and no one seemed to acknowledge her presence. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Kudumbashree's Flight Journey
videos.overview: One morning, the ladies of the house were excitedly getting ready for their first-ever flight with the Kudumbashree Community. Girirja wanted to join in, but Girirajan wouldn’t allow her. Determined to change things, Girirja began plotting ways to stop them from going. Will she pull it off? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Gas Cylinder
videos.overview: As we all know, the world is facing an LPG gas shortage due to the ongoing war between Israel and Iran. One, Cleatus and Ronald come to take the LPG gas cylinder from Kanakan’s home, assuring Ratnamma he’ll get a new one by evening. When Lilly returns and hears about the incident, she becomes upset and blames Ratnamma for letting them take it. That’s when Ratnamma decides to go old school—cooking in an aluminum pot on a traditional mud stove. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Girija's Gold Chain
videos.overview: One evening, Kanakan learns that Girija’s gold chain was stolen at the temple and swallowed by the thief to hide the evidence after being caught. Later, Kanakan tells the family that the chain has been found inside the thief’s body. Now the challenge is figuring out how to retrieve it. Will the police manage to succeed? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: One Chance
videos.overview: One morning, Rosemary storms into Cleatus’s place, upset and disappointed that she wasn’t invited to the opening of his new business. She asks Cleatus to give her the job and replace Sharmila. What happens next? Tune in to find out!

videos.title: The Money Challenge
videos.overview: Catch Aliyans every Monday to Friday at 7:30 PM on Kaumudy TV and the Kaumudy TV YouTube channel. Subscribe to the YouTube channel to enjoy your favorite content anytime, anywhere, and even download it to watch offline.

videos.title: I Love You
videos.overview: Lallu’s persistent efforts and increasing eagerness to meet Akshaya have been getting on her family’s nerves, especially after a matchmaker mistakenly showed them a suitor’s photo—only for it to be Lallu himself. While the mix-up was resolved quickly, the moment left her family even more worried about her. That’s when Ronald steps in. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: The House Redevelopment Plan
videos.overview: One late night, while Lilly was in bed, Kanakan stayed awake, murmuring to himself. Curious and a bit annoyed, Lilly woke up and asked why he was still up at this hour. Kanakan revealed his dream of redeveloping the whole house—tearing it down and building a bigger, better one. Excited, Lilly quickly shared the news with everyone except Cleatus. Even though Kanakan had told Cleatus he wanted to talk that evening, Cleatus went ahead with his own nasty plan. What will he do? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Eloped Girl
videos.overview: One morning, Kanakan and Lilly decide to spend the entire day out. After wandering for a while, they stop at a café for a glass of juice. Later, Kanakan spots a young girl with a man who looks distressed. Concerned, he steps in, only to discover that the girl has run away from home with her lover. How will Kanakan navigate such a delicate situation? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus in Trouble
videos.overview: One morning, while Cleatus and Shyamala were working in the office, they heard a noise. Stepping outside, they saw two RDP members putting up their party flags in front of Cleatus’s office. This upset Cleatus, leading to an altercation. Later, a man came to Cleatus’s home looking for him. When Cleatus wasn’t there, the man told his family he had been cheated and would file a police complaint if the matter wasn’t resolved soon. What lies ahead for Cleatus and his family? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus's Wit Saves the Day
videos.overview: One morning, a couple walks into Cleatus's office, asking him to sell their bungalow. But it’s not going to be an easy job, as they reveal the previous tenants experienced paranormal events tied to the man’s late mother, who passed away in the house. How will Cleatus solve this eerie mystery and manage to sell the place? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The New Dress
videos.overview: One morning at the breakfast table, Akshaya kept getting phone calls from someone. When her family asked about it, she lied, saying it was her teacher. She tried to brush the matter off, but Ronald sensed something was off. Later, she met Lallu, who gave her a dress. Soon after, she confessed to Ronald that she and Lallu were in love. Ronald was left confused, unsure whether to believe her or not. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Gold Pledge
videos.overview: One morning, Ronald put up posters promoting the new gold loan pledge services offered by We Help! Cleatus asked Girirajan for assistance but didn’t get a clear response. Later, a man came looking for Cleatus. After he left, Girirajan recognized him as a criminal who had been arrested long ago. Could Cleatus’s partnership with this man spell trouble? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Last Minute Idea
videos.overview: One morning, Natarajan visits the We Help Centre to ask Cleatus for help in finding a priest to conduct rituals for a housewarming ceremony for his wife Muthulakshmi’s relative. Cleatus confidently assures him that the task will be handled. But later that night, Sharmila calls to inform him that the priest has been suddenly hospitalized. Now, where will Cleatus find another priest for the ceremony? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Vishu Celebrations
videos.overview: One morning, Thankam and Lilly were busy preparing to tackle their own plans for the day. With no one available to gather the supplies for Vishu, Ratnamma felt disheartened and decided to forgo the celebration. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Ronald Leaves for His Home
videos.overview: One morning, Rosemary arrives at Cleatus's place to pick up Ronald, urging him to return home because his kids are longing to see him. Ronald does everything he can to avoid her, but Rosemary isn’t one to give up easily. Who will prevail? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Wife's Love
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus gets an urgent call from a client asking him to meet in Ernakulam. Soon after, Sharmila lets him know she can’t make it to the office due to personal reasons. With no one available to open the We Help office, Cleatus asks Thankam to cover for a day, but she declines because of other commitments. He then turns to Lilly for help. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: Cleatus and Sharmila's Professional Impasse
videos.overview: One morning, Sharmila shows up at Cleatus’s office to settle things between them. Though Cleatus tries to stick to his decision, Sharmila breaks down in tears, prompting him to take her back at work. Later, Thankam arrives and notices Sharmila’s tearful eyes but says nothing. At home, Cleatus and Thankam argue about the incident, with Thankam suspecting he might have a soft spot for Sharmila. Is she right? What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Thiruvathira
videos.overview: Just hours before the final day, Lilly asks Thankam and Sulu to join the Thiruvathira dance performance, as she’s short of two participants. Will they step in to help her? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Ronald Returns
videos.overview: One morning, Lilly and Thankam spotted Ronald sleeping outside Kanakan’s house. They were shocked and surprised to see him return so soon. How did he get back so quickly? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Eviction
videos.overview: One morning, Ratnamma’s friend drops by and pours out her troubles about the conflicts she’s having with her daughter and son-in-law. The daughter is trying to take over her property and send her away to an old age home. Ratnamma reassures her that her newly appointed son, the sub-inspector of police at the nearby police station, will handle the situation. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Gathering
videos.overview: Cleatus agrees to Kanakan's request to arrange someone to look after a hospitalized person. He assigns the task to Natarajan—will he manage to get it done successfully? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Beauty Named Sharmila
videos.overview: Thankam grows increasingly annoyed as Cleatus keeps getting calls from Sharmila. Soon, she starts suspecting that something more might be going on between them. How will Thankam handle this situation? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: An Altercation Between Lilly and Thankam
videos.overview: Once again, Lilly and Thankam find themselves in an argument, with Lilly upset that Thankam offered a job opportunity to someone else instead of her. Frustrated, teams up with Ronald to teach Thankam a lesson. Will their plan work? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Elopement
videos.overview: One day, Lilly and Kanakan were spending time together. After a while, they arrived at a restaurant for some refreshments. That’s when Kanakan noticed a man and a girl sitting together, looking scared and tense. As he observed them, he realized he had seen that man somewhere before. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Akshaya and Lallu's Growing Love Story
videos.overview: One night, Ronald has a disturbing dream in which he sees Akshaya running away with Lallu in the middle of the night, carrying all their belongings. Shaken by this, Ronald begins to keep a close eye on both of them. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Unknown Enemy
videos.overview: One morning, concern grew for Kanakan as he kept receiving threatening calls from an unknown source. Can he uncover the identity of this faceless enemy before trouble finds him? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Loving Lion
videos.overview: One morning, Takkuddu and Saiyyu asked Thankam for permission to go swimming with their friends, but Thankam firmly refused. They then turned to Ronald with the same request, but he was uncertain and said he’d think about it. Later, while Ronald was riding his scooter somewhere, Kanakan fined him for not wearing a helmet, leaving Ronald upset by the incident. What happens next? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Amazing Village Tour
videos.overview: It’s summer, and Cleatus has planned an exciting village tour for the whole family, topped off with a surprise that everyone will love. Stay tuned to see what’s in store!

videos.title: Double Omelette
videos.overview: The story follows an omelette that stirs up chaos in Kanakan and Cleatus's family. Tune in to catch the full plot!

videos.title: Sharmila's Lie Gets Caught
videos.overview: One morning, Cleatus overheard Sharmila chatting with her friend, plotting to tell him a lie so she could watch a movie. Will her plan work?

videos.title: Came Like a Mountain, Went by a Mouse
videos.overview: Lilly and Thankam ask Kanakan to help Sulu with her family troubles, but Kanakan prefers to stay out of their personal issues. Will he stick to his decision or step in to help Sulu? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Rooster and the Raw Bananas
videos.overview: When Girirajan arrived at his sister's place, he noticed a rooster pecking at some grains. Trying to shoo it away, he accidentally threw a pebble that ended up killing it. Later, he learned it was Thankam's prized rooster. Panicked, Girirajan starts scrambling to find an identical replacement, so Thankam won’t suspect a thing. But that’s just the beginning—there’s more to the story. Watch now to find out!

videos.title: The Snake
videos.overview: One day, Takkuddu spots a snake. To scare it off, he tosses a pebble at it, but the snake slips away and slithers into the house. How will the family manage to drive it out? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: A Marriage in Kerala
videos.overview: Cleatus takes on the responsibility of conducting the wedding of a boy and a girl from UP in Kerala. Everything goes smoothly until he gets a phone call revealing that, despite a background check, the girl is actually a minor. This shocking mistake could land Cleatus in serious trouble, possibly even leading to his arrest. What happens next? Watch to find out!

videos.title: The Thief and the Police
videos.overview: Cleatus borrowed money from Girirajan, but when it came time to repay, he couldn’t gather the funds because of a looming scandal. How will he manage to pay it back? Watch now to find out!

videos.title: Love is Pain
videos.overview: One morning, as Akshaya was on her way back from somewhere, Lallu spotted her and invited her to have coconut water together. Somehow, this news reached Ronald, prompting him to confront Akshaya. Later Akshaya and Lallu’s secret plan to meet at the temple fell through when Lallu couldn’t make it. What happens next? Watch now to find out!
